segments.name: Homeowners
segments.description: Homeowners insurance written through Hippo's owned program and third-party program partners, managed on an aggregate basis.
segments.evidence: Our reported Homeowners line of business is a combination of policies written by our owned program and polices written by third-party program partners.

segments.name: Renters
segments.description: Short-tail personal lines coverage protecting personal property and contents of rented residences, underwritten by a third-party program administrator.
segments.evidence: The Renters line is a short-tail personal lines coverage typically providing protection for personal property and contents of rented residences.

segments.name: Casualty
segments.description: Liability insurance covering bodily injury, property damage and defense costs, written through delegated authority arrangements with program administrators and MGAs.
segments.evidence: Casualty consists of liability insurance products with short to medium tail loss characteristics.

segments.name: Commercial Multi-Peril ("CMP")
segments.description: Commercial property and packaged property and liability coverage for small to mid-sized commercial insureds under a single policy.
segments.evidence: Commercial Multi-Peril includes commercial property and packaged property and liability coverage for small to mid-sized commercial insureds under a single policy.

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Individually immaterial insurance products and programs, including runoff and discontinued programs reported through policy expiration.
segments.evidence: Other includes insurance products and programs that are not material on an individual basis.

revenueModel.text: Hippo earns premium from policyholders and fee income from MGAs using its licensed carrier platform, combining stable fee income with selective risk retention.
revenueModel.evidence: Hippo focuses on balanced, diversified growth by combining stable fee income from its carrier platform with selective risk retention across personal and commercial lines—participating in the underwriting results of high-performing MGA programs.
